title: A one-to-one relationship adds a blank row to the table that lacks a matching row

source.quote: This join type ensures that blank virtual rows are added on either side, when necessary
source.supports: blank rows are added on either side of a one-to-one relationship

source.quote: Notice that the Category value for product SKU CL-02 is BLANK
source.supports: the unmatched product shows under a BLANK category

derivation: Clothing filters Product to CL-01: 1. Accessories to AC-01: 1. Jeans (CL-02) has no ProductCategory row, so ProductCategory gets a blank row, and filtering it leaves the unmatched Product row: 1.
alternative: If the engine adds no blank row to ProductCategory, the result has only the rows (Clothing, 1) and (Accessories, 1).
notes: The sources state the blank row and show the BLANK category in a visual, but none shows a query result for a measure on that blank row.
